svg.text: Loop 2 — remediation, repeats until the verdict clears
Cut a vertical slice — sized for efficiency,
not minimalism: a coherent capability that
ships and reviews on its own · in INDEX.md
every task written · decisions listed, not made
open decisions OD-n, each with a recommendation
a person rules on each OD-n → DECISIONS.md
every ruling folded into its task
the pasted output IS the evidence
EXTRACT the ledger, then VERIFY every row
one row per leaf promise · the denominator
risk-tier the diff · tier 1 read line by line
tier 3 trusted only behind a FULL-suite run
adversarial pass · recorded as QR-n in REVIEW.md
Spec decision FIRST — add the leaf
to the specs, or a dated drop
nothing open — frozen in the same run
no — a scoped run is enough
